title: 第九章 宝术逞威第十章 兑换第十一章 买
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
大雄宝殿之外哪怕杀戮四起，最夺人眼球的还是朵儿察处。
朵儿察身为半步外景，举手投足之间就隐隐勾连天地法理，狂风与雷鸣相随，天地自然之力使他哪怕以一敌二，也牢牢占据上风，取胜不过是时间问题。
见久久无法取得战果，前来相助的女施主也即将坚持不住，心寂轻叹佛号，动用了压箱底之物。
手腕上的一串佛珠闪烁微光，接连炸开，每一粒都在半空形成一尊佛陀的虚影，这使得此地一时间如同灵山净土，再非凡俗。
“一切诸相，即是非相，一切众生，即非众生。”
浩瀚佛音回荡在横尸遍野的广场上，一时之间，净土与地狱同在，有种说不出的奇诡。
一脸肃穆的心寂抓住时机，右掌金灿灿的发出微光，轻飘飘便将独脚铜人击碎。
大力金刚掌！
自开战以来，朵儿察首次变得认真，遍布伤痕的右拳紧握，打向金灿灿的手掌。
轰隆！
乌云滚滚的天空发出闷响，一道美得惊心动魄的闪电劈落，似有灵性般，环绕在朵儿察的右拳。
大音希声！
两人拳掌相交的这一刻，时间都仿佛静止了一般，天地一片寂静，厮杀之声戛然而止。
不知过去多久，似一瞬似永恒，一道凄美绝伦的剑光乍现。剑光冥冥之中契合了不可言说的‘道’，避无可避，命中注定，有一种无法言说的魅力，似是穷极天地枢机变化。
“啊！”
朵儿察凄厉惨叫。
狂风再起，雷电轰鸣。
心寂方丈倒飞出去的同时，朵儿察牢牢抓住了刺入左眼的白虹贯日剑，狂风环绕在右手，打向江芷薇。
势大力沉的一拳直直打中江芷薇较弱的身躯，霎时间，江芷薇吐出大口鲜血，身子倒飞进大雄宝殿中，右臂因死死抓着白虹贯日剑，整个被撕裂下来。
眼眶中流出暗红色血液，夹杂着奇怪液体，这使得朵儿察看上去仿佛疯魔。他步迈开就要进入大雄宝殿将江芷薇击毙，毁眼之仇不共戴天，他甚至都没选择先杀掉重伤的心寂方丈。

“站住！”
发现情况不妙的林阳大喝一声，强忍着内心的恐惧感，冲向朵儿察。他狂奔之下，大地崩裂了一条条触目惊心的裂痕，整座山体都似乎微微颤动着，如同地龙翻身。
“螳臂当车！”
朵儿察话语冰冷森寒，透露出十足的杀意。
林阳眼前好似出现尸山血海，无穷无尽的血腥味刺激的他只想呕吐，朵儿察好似化身为地狱走出的恶鬼，欲择人而噬。
“死！”
林阳怒吼壮胆，全力一拳打出，体内血液流动发出滚滚雷鸣，血肉之中有一缕缕的神曦绽放。
朵儿察露出慎重之色，不复刚才的不屑一顾。
从这破绽百出的一拳上他嗅到了死亡的味道。
“拙劣不堪。”
朵儿察的话语自狂风中传出，他不同和心寂交战招招相击，选择了躲避。同时抓住一闪即逝的时机，将防备不及的林阳击飞。
他改变主意了，要先杀掉林阳这个祸患再谈其它，心寂性命都无所谓了。否则等林阳搏斗经验丰富了，实在是太过可怕，他都不能将其压制。
“如此人物，若是我蛮族之人，必定能成为蛮族战神，可悲，可叹，今日你就要命丧于此。”
content_en:
Even if there are killings everywhere outside the main hall, the one that catches the most attention is Duoer Chachu.
Duo'ercha's body is half a step outside, and his movements are vaguely connected to the laws of heaven and earth. Strong winds and thunder are accompanied by strong winds and thunder. The natural power of heaven and earth allows him to firmly gain the upper hand even if he is one against two. It is only a matter of time before he wins.
Seeing that the victory could not be achieved for a long time, the female benefactor who came to help could no longer hold on any longer. She sighed softly at the Buddha's name in silence and used the things at the bottom of the box.
A string of Buddhist beads on the wrist shimmered and exploded one after another. Each beads formed a shadow of the Buddha in mid-air. This made this place feel like a pure land on a spiritual mountain, which was extraordinary.
"All appearances are right and wrong, and all sentient beings are not sentient beings."
The vast Buddha's voice echoed in the square littered with corpses. For a moment, the pure land and hell were coexisting, which was indescribably strange.
With a solemn look on his face, Xinji seized the opportunity, his right palm shimmered with golden light, and lightly smashed the one-legged bronze man into pieces.
Powerful Vajra Palm!
For the first time since the war started, Dorcha became serious. His scarred right fist clenched and hit the golden palm.
Boom!
The sky with rolling dark clouds made a muffled sound, and a breathtakingly beautiful bolt of lightning struck down, surrounding Dorcha's right fist like something spiritual.
Great sound!
At the moment when the two fists met, time seemed to have stopped. The world was silent, and the sound of fighting stopped abruptly.
I don’t know how much time passed, but it seemed like an eternity, and a beautiful and poignant sword light suddenly appeared. The sword light is in harmony with the indescribable 'Tao'. It is inevitable and destined. It has an indescribable charm, which seems to be the ultimate change of the world.
"Ah!"
Doercha screamed miserably.
The wind picked up again and thunder and lightning roared.
While Abbot Xinji flew backwards, Duoercha firmly grasped the White Rainbow Sun Sword that pierced his left eye. The strong wind surrounded his right hand and hit Jiang Zhiwei.
A powerful and heavy punch hit Jiang Zhiwei's weaker body. In an instant, Jiang Zhiwei spit out a large mouthful of blood and flew upside down into the main hall. Her right arm was torn off because she was holding on to the White Rainbow Sun Sword.
Dark red blood flowed from the eye sockets, mixed with strange liquid, which made Doercha look like a madman. He took one step forward and was about to enter the main hall and kill Jiang Zhiwei. The hatred for Destruction of Eyes was irreconcilable, and he didn't even choose to kill the seriously injured Abbot Xinji first.
"Stop!"
Lin Yang, who realized that the situation was not good, shouted loudly, suppressed the fear in his heart, and rushed towards Duoercha. As he ran wildly, the earth cracked with shocking cracks, and the entire mountain seemed to tremble slightly, like an earth dragon turning over.
"The mantis' arms are like a chariot!"
Duoercha's words were cold and cold, revealing full murderous intent.
A mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood seemed to appear in front of Lin Yang's eyes. The endless smell of blood made him want to vomit. Duoercha seemed to have transformed into an evil ghost coming out of hell, wanting to choose people and devour them.
"Death!"
Lin Yang roared with courage and punched with all his strength. The blood flow in his body made a roaring sound, and wisps of divine light bloomed in his flesh and blood.
Duoercha showed a cautious look, no longer dismissive as before.
He smelled death from this punch that was full of flaws.
"Clumsy."
Dorcha's words came out from the strong wind. Instead of fighting with Xinji and attacking each other, he chose to escape. At the same time, he seized the fleeting opportunity and knocked Lin Yang away who was unprepared.
He changed his mind. He wanted to kill Lin Yang, the scourge, before talking about anything else. His life would not matter if he was calm. Otherwise, when Lin Yang has more fighting experience, it will be too terrifying and he will not be able to suppress it.
"Such a person, if he were a member of our barbarian tribe, he would definitely become the barbarian god of war. It's sad, it's a pity that you will die here today."
